name: Auth0
label: Auth0 Management API v2 — users, roles, clients, logs
description: Official Auth0 Management API v2. Bearer access_token is a Management API token the operator already minted (this node does not exchange client credentials). domain is host only. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Tenant user/log data is personal data — minimize. Never log access_token. listen is BPMN message-event ingress. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Path {id} is user id, role is not used as path except assign-role uses user id. Do not put access_token here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config when non-blank. EXACT: create-user | get-user | list-users | update-user | delete-user | create-role | list-roles | assign-role | list-clients | get-log | list-logs | listen.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Path id: user_id (auth0|…), or log_id for get-log. Path-encoded.

schema.label: connection
schema.description: create-user required. Database or passwordless connection name. Example: Username-Password-Authentication.

schema.label: email
schema.description: User email (RFC 5322). Required for most database create-user calls.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Display name (users) or role name (create-role; required for create-role).

schema.label: description
schema.description: Role description for create-role.

schema.label: roles
schema.description: assign-role: array of existing role ids. Example: ["rol_…"]. New roles cannot be created here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Search query for list-users (v3 syntax) or list-logs (log query syntax).

schema.label: page
schema.description: 0-based page index for list-users, list-roles, list-clients, list-logs.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size. Typical max 100. list-logs search is capped at 1000 total results.

schema.label: from
schema.description: list-logs checkpoint cursor (log id to search from).

schema.label: take
schema.description: list-logs checkpoint page size when using from.

schema.label: password
schema.description: Database connection password for create-user / update-user. Never log. Prefer a StudioQuack secret binding when storing a new user secret.

schema.label: given_name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `given_name` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: family_name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `family_name` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: nickname
schema.description: Request-body parameter `nickname` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: username
schema.description: Request-body parameter `username` for operation: create-user.

schema.label: picture
schema.description: Request-body parameter `picture` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: user_metadata
schema.description: user_metadata object for create-user / update-user. Example: {"plan":"pro"}.

schema.label: app_metadata
schema.description: app_metadata object for create-user / update-user (elevated). Example: {"roles":["admin"]}.

schema.label: email_verified
schema.description: create-user / update-user email_verified flag.

schema.label: verify_email
schema.description: create-user: send a verification email when true.

schema.label: phone_number
schema.description: Request-body parameter `phone_number` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: blocked
schema.description: create-user / update-user blocked flag.

schema.label: search_engine
schema.description: Query-string parameter `search_engine` for operation: list-users.

schema.label: include_totals
schema.description: Query-string parameter `include_totals` for operations: list-users, list-roles, list-clients.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: Query-string parameter `sort` for operations: list-users, list-logs.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Query-string parameter `fields` for operations: list-users, list-clients, list-logs.

schema.label: name_filter
schema.description: Query-string parameter `name_filter` for operation: list-roles.

schema.label: include_fields
schema.description: Query-string parameter `include_fields` for operations: list-clients, list-logs.

ports.name: output
ports.description: 2xx: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Management API JSON. Do not log user PII or tokens.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank. listen is ingress (BPMN message event).

configurationParameters.label: Management API token
configurationParameters.description: Already-minted Management API access token (Authorization: Bearer). StudioQuack secret. Scope to the verbs you call (create:users, read:users, update:users, delete:users, create:roles, read:roles, read:clients, read:logs). Never on INPUT or in logs.

configurationParameters.label: Tenant host
configurationParameters.description: Host only, no scheme, no path. Canonical tenant host or custom domain host. Example: tenant.us.auth0.com.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: Log Stream Auth Header
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header Authorization. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: Authorization).
